points.description: States that the parameters K and x are assumed constant (not changing with time) for the reach.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of K or x is mentioned as constant, or constancy is stated vaguely.

points.description: States that the storage–discharge relation is linear (storage depends linearly on inflow and outflow, m = 1), and/or that the method applies to channel routing.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says the relation is linear or the method is for channels without clear detail.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that K and x are constant over time, and that the relation is linear (m = 1) or the method is for channel reach routing. Give part marks for one correct assumption stated or a vague version of both. Give no marks for unrelated or wrong answers; ignore the model answer's odd 'x = 1' wording and extra incorrect remarks unless they contradict the central ideas.
